title: American Fiction
description:
S1 E1
Fed up with the establishment profiting from Black entertainment that relies on offensive tropes, a frustrated novelist decides to write an outlandish Black book of his own, one that propels him to the heart of the hypocrisy he disdains.

title: Top Five
description:
S1 E1
Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.

title: Head of State
description:
S1 E1
When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

title: Menace II Society
description:
S1 E1
In an unflinching look at the mean streets of the contemporary urban American ghetto, a Black youth—despite his dreams for a better life—ultimately succumbs to the cycle of violence that pervades his community.

title: Paid in Full
description:
S1 E1
A young man from Harlem, forced to cope with the 1980s drug scene, builds an illegal empire, only to have a crisis of conscience.  Featuring the hit soundtrack with songs by Eric B. & Rakim, Boogie Down Productions, Guy, and Jay-Z.

title: Baby Boy
description:
S1 E1
Jody is a 20-year-old African American in South Central L.A. who is trying to live large but doesn't have a job. Growing up is tough on Jody, but a series of events force him to learn lessons about living, loving and surviving as a man in the hood.
